description: This script processes HTTP performance logs to extract timing, size, and rate information, and performs data bucketization and smoothing for analysis.

methods.name: resets()
methods.description: Reads the input log file and extracts timestamps associated with 'SIGNAL_STRENGTH' signals.

methods.name: augment()
methods.description: Reads the log file, processes lines containing 'Pulled' to compute time deltas, and outputs the augmented log.

methods.name: chew()
methods.description: Parses 'Pulled' lines to compute total data transfer time, total bytes, rate, and buckets data over time with smoothing.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point that triggers the chew() processing function.
